theorems.statement: (∀ (d : ℕ) (Z : Set (Euclid d)) (y : Euclid d), Tendsto (fun r => volume (Z ∩ closedBall y r) / volume (closedBall y r)) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 1) → ∀ v : Euclid d, ‖v‖ = 1 → ∃ ys : ℕ → Euclid d, (∀ i, ys i ∈ Z ∧ ys i ≠ y) ∧ Tendsto ys atTop (𝓝 y) ∧ Tendsto (fun i => ‖ys i - y‖⁻¹ • (ys i - y)) atTop (𝓝 v)) → ∀ (m P : ℕ) (Z : Set (Euclid m)) (F : Euclid m → ℝ) (ψ : Euclid m → Euclid P) (f : Euclid P → ℝ) (L : NNReal), MeasurableSet Z → (∀ y ∈ Z, DifferentiableAt ℝ F y ∧ DifferentiableAt ℝ ψ y) → (∀ y ∈ Z, f (ψ y) = F y) → LipschitzWith L f → ∀ᵐ y ∂volume, y ∈ Z → ∀ e : Euclid m, |fderiv ℝ F y e| ≤ (L : ℝ) * ‖fderiv ℝ ψ y e‖
